worldcombat.skill.infernalparade.summary: Summon a parade of spectral fireballs that scatter, then wheel around and home in on the target. The total power is split across the wisps; if even one lands it may burn. Against a target carrying any status condition the whole parade is doubled.
worldcombat.skill.infernalparade.descrip: One cast summons %1$s wisps that scatter across a %2$s degree half-angle before turning.

The parade deals %1$s special damage in total, split across the wisps; each flies at %2$s blocks per tick and turns at most %3$s degrees per tick. Only an aimed enemy entity is tracked; on a bare direction or ground aim the wisps fly straight along the aim, and when the target leaves they keep their last heading to the end. If the target carries a burn, paralysis, poison, frozen or sleep, the whole total is doubled.

If at least one wisp lands, there is a %1$s chance to burn the target for %2$s (fire types and other burn-immune targets are unaffected): while burning it deals half physical damage and loses about 6.25%% of its maximum health every 5 seconds (at least 1 point), until it expires or is cured. Wisps fly straight for %3$s ticks before homing.
worldcombat.skill.infernalparade.use.2: Light them up for an ally
worldcombat.skill.infernalparade.prefere: On: one more wisp and homing turn ×1.3, but flight speed ×0.8 and 2/5 ticks more recover and cooldown. Off: faster and cheaper, baseline turn.
Beyond this distance the user closes in before dancing.
When on, the user may leave its post to find a firing line; when off, it only fires on what it can reach from where it stands.
